initial_rules: FAIL any visible scratch, stain, or surface damage; PASS otherwise.
final_rules: FAIL any visible scratch, stain, or surface damage; PASS otherwise.

rounds.rules: Inspect the cable cross-section against the known-good reference for overall structure and condition, not just surface marks. PASS only if conductor count, arrangement, shape, insulation layers and outer sheath are all present, intact, correctly positioned and consistent with the reference, allowing normal variation such as speckled copper texture, light reflections, and minor brightness, color or focus differences that also appear in good parts. Do not FAIL for that normal texture and lighting alone. Do not PASS a part only because no scratch, stain or surface damage is obvious - FAIL for any structural or material defect even without a clear scratch or stain, including missing, extra, deformed, flattened, cracked, misaligned or incomplete cores or strands, voids, bubbles, cuts, exposed conductors, foreign material, or abnormal discoloration, corrosion, swelling or sheath damage.
rounds.rationale: Broadened FAIL criteria beyond scratches and stains to catch missed structural cross-section defects, while explicitly whitelisting speckled texture and reflections as normal to prevent false alarms.
